title: Cloudy Days
program: Louis le Prince International Short Film Competition
description: A middle-aged woman from Vietnam with a little son from her first marriage, remarries an older man. Devoted as she is to her husband, she is not treated as his family member. Repressed desire makes her turn to her stepson, a considerate and amiable man.
cast: Ho Jr Ren David needs help. So does David. A severely depressed man reaches out for an emergency therapy session but he’s not the only one who needs help
in this absurd comedy starring Will Ferrell.
